title: ProductMetadata
description: metadata.json produced by ingestion-svc and consumed by preprocessing-svc (Member 2). Source of truth is app/models.py::ProductMetadata; this file is regenerated from that model and validated by tests/test_contract.py::test_metadata_schema_matches_models.

sensor_type.description: Sensor kind of the input product.

sun_azimuth_deg.description: Sun azimuth in degrees, [0, 360). Null when sun_angle_source_tier is 'unavailable'.

sun_elevation_deg.description: Sun elevation above horizon in degrees. Null when sun_angle_source_tier is 'unavailable'.

sun_angle_source_tier.description: How the Sun angles were obtained. 'unavailable' triggers downstream image-based estimation.

projection.description: WKT or EPSG/proj string for the image frame.

footprint_wkt.description: WKT footprint polygon of the product. Null when not available.

band_count.description: Number of spectral bands in the raw image.

acquisition_time.description: ISO-8601 acquisition timestamp with Z (UTC) timezone. Optional; accepted but not yet used downstream.
